title: zscalerctl resource semantics output
description: Candidate v1 schema for the config-free, tenant-value-free resource semantics pilot. The pilot currently reviews only zia/locations, zia/url-filtering-rules, and zia/rule-labels; known resources outside the pilot are emitted with review_status not_reviewed and an empty fields array.

$schema.description: Candidate resource semantics document identifier. The published JSON Schema identity is the file $id.

review_status.description: Whether the resource has reviewed field semantics in this bounded pilot.

redaction_mode.description: Active catalog redaction mode used to select the field descriptors.

read_only.description: True because this metadata describes tenant-read-only catalog resources and performs no tenant access.

product.description: Product family containing the catalog resource.

resource.description: Catalog resource name within the product family.

operations.description: Read-only catalog operations advertised for the resource.

get_key.description: Effective catalog key used by a get operation. Omitted for list-only and singleton show resources.

fields.description: Reviewed, active-mode field descriptors. Empty when review_status is not_reviewed or when the catalog mode omits every reviewed field.

capability.description: Tenant capability. Resource semantics are read-only.

type.description: Known SDK wire shape. This metadata does not assert that a tenant sends the field, sends null, or omits it.

description.description: Reviewed description sourced from the upstream SDK model.

classification.description: Existing catalog classification copied without introducing a new renderable field or reclassifying it.

allowed_modes.description: Existing catalog mode gates for the field.

enum.description: Optional closed set, populated only when verified by a primary upstream source.

reference.description: Verified target catalog resource for a reference-valued field.

source.description: Primary repository source paths used for the field review.

ordering.description: No stable collection ordering guarantee was verified. SDK slice order is not treated as an API guarantee.

product.description: Product family of the verified target catalog resource.

resource.description: Name of the verified target catalog resource.

sdk_path.description: Repository path to the vendored upstream SDK model and comments.

catalog_path.description: Repository path to the existing catalog field allow-list and mode gate.
